en: A colorized historic street scene showing a broad square with people walking and riding in horse-drawn carriages. On the right are several red-brick buildings, and on the left a tree-lined area with a small pavilion or kiosk. The image has printed location captions at the top and a handwritten message across the bottom. A white strip at the bottom margin contains catalog information and the name of the Gothenburg City Museum.
